name: nexus_get_mod_endorsers
description:
List users who endorsed a mod via v2 GraphQL [v2 - no v1 quota].

Resolves the mod's uid first (two-step, both cached).

Returns:
    JSON {pageInfo: {endCursor, hasNextPage}, nodes: [{memberId, name,
    avatar, modCount, kudos, ...}]}. Paginate with after_cursor.

after_cursor.description: Cursor from a previous page's pageInfo.endCursor.
after_cursor.title: After Cursor

domain_name.description: Nexus Mods game domain (lowercase URL slug), e.g. 'forzahorizon6', 'skyrimse'. NOT the display name.
domain_name.title: Domain Name
